'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***[[2025 Catatumbo attacks]]
****[[President of Colombia|Colombian president]] [[Gustavo Petro]] declares a [[state of emergency]] in response to [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|rebel]] attacks in the [[Catatumbo region]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/colombia-to-declare-state-of-emergency-as-violence-in-northern-regions-spikes/ar-AA1xy0fj (MSN)]
****The death toll from fighting in the [[Catatumbo region]], [[Colombia]], increases to more than 100 as the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] (ELN) launches more attacks. The [[Government of Colombia|Colombian government]] vows "war" against the ELN with [[President of Colombia|Colombian president]] [[Gustavo Petro]] saying that the group has "chosen the path of war, and a war they will have". [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jan/20/colombia-guerrilla-violence-deaths (''The Guardian'')]
****More than 11,000 people flee to the city of [[Cúcuta]] as ELN rebels clash with the 33rd Front of the [[FARC dissidents]]. Authorities say more than 20,000 people have now been  [[Internally displaced person|internally displaced]] due to recent fighting. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250120-colombia-troops-try-to-contain-guerrilla-violence-that-has-killed-100 (France 24)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Drone warfare|drones attack]] industrial facilities in [[Tatarstan]], [[Russia]], prompting the Russian [[Federal Air Transport Agency]] to temporarily suspend flights at [[Kazan International Airport]] in [[Kazan]] and [[Begishevo Airport]] in [[Nizhnekamsk]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/drones-attack-russian-military-industrial-hub-600-miles/story?id=117876447 (ABC News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**An [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] reservist is killed and four others are injured, including a senior officer in critical condition, after their [[MDT David]] light armored vehicle hits a roadside bomb during a patrol in [[Tammun]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-reservist-killed-two-others-wounded-by-roadside-bomb-in-west-bank-overnight/ (''Times of Israel'')]
**The [[Palestinian Civil Defence]] (PCD) states that the remains of 137 people have been recovered from [[Rafah]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] since the start of the [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|ceasefire]]. The PCD estimates that there are 10,000 bodies buried under rubble left to be recovered. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/1/20/live-palestinian-prisoners-freed-by-israel-after-captives-released-in-gaza?update=3454862 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Kingdom Holding Company|Kingdom Holding]] announces the resumption of construction on the {{conv|1000|m}}-tall [[Jeddah Tower]] in [[Saudi Arabia]], which is expected to be the [[List of tallest buildings|world's tallest building]]. [https://www.alarabiya.net/aswaq/realestate/2025/01/20/-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%85%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A6%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%A3%D8%B9%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%AC-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B7%D9%88%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85 (Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Pardon of January 6 United States Capitol attack defendants]]
***[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] formally [[pardon]]s around 1,500 defendants who had been [[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack|criminally charged]] with involvement in the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|January 6 attack]] on the [[United States Capitol]]. Fourteen convicted individuals have their sentences [[Commutation (law)|commuted]] to time served. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/trump-set-pardon-defendants-stormed-capitol-jan-6-2021-rcna187735 (NBC News)]
*[[2024 Kolkata rape and murder]]
**A court in [[Kolkata]], [[India]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] a 33-year-old [[Kolkata Police|police]] volunteer to [[life in prison]] for [[rape in India|raping]] and [[murder in Indian law|murdering]] a medical trainee in August 2024. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-man-jailed-for-life-in-doctor-rape-murder-case/a-71346298 (DW)]
*[[2024 Southport stabbing]]
**[[Axel Rudakubana]] pleads guilty to all 16 [[criminal charge|charges]], including three charges of [[murder in English law|murder]] in relation to a [[mass stabbing]] in [[Southport]], [[Merseyside]], [[England]], in July 2024. Rudakubana is expected to be sentenced on Thursday. [https://www.itv.com/news/granada/2025-01-20/rudakubana-changes-pleas-to-guilty-on-first-day-of-trial-for-southport-attack (ITV News)]
*[[Capital punishment in China]]
**[[China]] [[capital punishment|executes]] the perpetrators of the [[2024 Zhuhai car attack]] and the [[2024 Wuxi stabbing attack]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/20/china-executes-two-men-for-committing-deadly-revenge-on-society-crimes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[China–Philippines relations]]
**[[Philippine National Police|Philippine police]] arrest a [[Academic institutions of the armed forces of China|student]] of the [[People's Liberation Army]] for allegedly attempting to [[Chinese intelligence activity abroad|spy]] on several [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|military]] facilities, including [[United States bases in the Philippines|U.S.-accessible bases]] under the [[Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-arrests-chinese-national-suspicion-espionage-2025-01-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Presidency of Joe Biden]]
**Outgoing U.S. President [[Joe Biden]] announces pre-emptive [[Federal pardons in the United States|pardon]]s for [[Family of Joe Biden|his siblings]], former [[Chief Medical Advisor to the President|Chief Medical Advisor]] [[Anthony Fauci]], former [[Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff]] [[Mark Milley]] and members of the [[January 6th Committee|House Select Committee on the January 6 Attack]] prior to [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Second inauguration of Donald Trump|inauguration]]. Biden also [[commutation (law)|commutes]] the sentence of Indigenous activist and convicted murderer [[Leonard Peltier]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2025/01/20/biden-pardons-fauci-milley-jan-6-committee-00199244 (Politico)] [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/joe-biden-leonard-peltier-clemency_n_67608b04e4b0d06419ec6367 (''HuffPost'')]
*Eight people are killed and seven others are injured in an [[arson]] attack at a [[nursing home]] in [[Barajevo]], [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eight-die-seven-injured-serbian-retirement-home-fire-2025-01-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Second inauguration of Donald Trump]]
***[[Donald Trump]] and [[JD Vance]] are [[Inauguration|inaugurated]] as the [[List of presidents of the United States|47th]] [[President of the United States|president]] and [[List of vice presidents of the United States|50th]] [[Vice President of the United States|vice president of the United States]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], with Trump becoming the first president since [[Grover Cleveland]] to serve non-consecutive terms. [https://apnews.com/live/trump-inauguration-updates (AP)]
***The inauguration is held indoors in the [[United States Capitol]] [[United States Capitol rotunda|rotunda]] due to extreme cold temperatures, making it the first inauguration since [[Second inauguration of Ronald Reagan|1985]] to be held indoors.  [https://www.today.com/news/politics/donald-trump-2025-indoor-inauguration-weather-rcna188400 (Today.com)]
***During celebrations of the inauguration, businessman [[Elon Musk]] makes [[Elon Musk salute controversy|two gestures]] to a crowd at the [[Capital One Arena]] that some on social media liken to [[Nazi salute]]s. The gestures were made as Musk thanked the crowd, stating "My heart goes out to you." Musk denied any meaning behind the gestures. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy48v1x4dv4o (BBC News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/elon-musk-salute-trump-inauguration-b2683095.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2025/1/21/musk-accused-of-giving-nazi-salute-during-trump-inauguration-celebrations (AJ)]
**[[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
***On his first day of his second term, Trump signs his first executive orders on [[LGBTQ rights in the United States|gender]] and [[Immigration to the United States|immigration]], and also signs an order ending usage of the [[CBP One]] app. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/2025/01/20/nation/donald-trump-executive-orders/ (''Boston Globe'')]
***Trump signs the [[Putting America First In International Environmental Agreements]] executive order directing the [[United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement|U.S. to withdraw from the Paris Agreement]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-paris-agreement-climate-change-788907bb89fe307a964be757313cdfb0 (AP)]
***Trump signs an executive order directing the [[United States withdrawal from the World Health Organization|U.S. to withdraw from the World Health Organization]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-signs-executive-withdrawing-world-health-organization-2025-01-21/ (Reuters)]
***Trump signs executive orders calling for the renaming the [[Gulf of Mexico]] to the "Gulf of America" and for [[Denali]] to [[Denali–Mount McKinley naming dispute|return to its former name]] "Mount McKinley". The rename would apply to all references from the [[Federal government of the United States|federal government]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-rename-gulf-of-mexico-denali/ (CBS News)]
***Trump declares [[Illegal immigration to the United States|illegal immigration]] a [[List of national emergencies in the United States|national emergency]] under the [[National Emergencies Act]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-declare-national-emergency-border-trump-official-says-2025-01-20/ (Reuters)]
***Trump officially creates the [[Department of Government Efficiency]] (DOGE) led by [[Elon Musk]] aimed at cutting spending of the U.S. government. DOGE is a temporary organization under the [[United States DOGE Service]], not a [[United States federal executive departments|federal executive department]]. Within minutes of the announcement, government employee unions, watchdog groups, and public interest organizations sued over this executive order. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-use-one-his-first-executive-orders-create-doge-semafor-reports-2025-01-20/ (Reuters)]
***Trump signs an executive order to delay enforcement of the [[Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act|law]] [[Restrictions on TikTok in the United States|banning]] [[TikTok]] in the United States for 75 days. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/20/tech/tiktok-future-donald-trump-ban-sale/index.html (CNN)]
***Trump revokes Biden's removal of [[Cuba]] from the [[State Sponsors of Terrorism (U.S. list)|state sponsors of terrorism list]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/trump-revokes-biden-removal-cuba-us-state-sponsors-terrorism-list-2025-01-21/ (Reuters)]
**[[Protests against Donald Trump]]
***[[Protests against the second presidency of Donald Trump|Anti-Trump protests]] are held in cities across the [[United States]], as well as in other countries, such as [[Mexico]], [[Panama]], and the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/gallery/2025/jan/20/anti-trump-protests-photos (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Second cabinet of Donald Trump]]
***The [[United States Senate]] unanimously confirms [[Marco Rubio]] as [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]], making him the first Cabinet official of Trump's second term to be confirmed by the Senate. Rubio also becomes the first [[Hispanic and Latino Americans|Latino American]] to serve as Secretary of State. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/5096622-senate-confirms-marco-rubio-secretary/ (''The Hill'')]

**In [[American football]], the [[Ohio State Buckeyes football|Ohio State Buckeyes]] win their 9th [[college football]] championship, [[2024 Notre Dame Fighting Irish football team|defeating]] the [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish football team|Notre Dame Fighting Irish]].
